description: Two-player game where Player 1 has populated poison, experience, energy, commander damage received from Player 2, and a generic Monarch counter, while Player 2 has none. Proves the additive counter contract (DEC-102) adds a single deterministic counter line only for the populated player without changing existing prompt behavior.

request.question: What is the current poison and commander damage state in this game?
